scoring: Judge actual language, scope, evidence, recipients, timing and business states; receipts are not semantic scores.

goals.label: Derivative ownership and actual publication chain
goals.activation: Applies to the separate pattern, translation and withdrawn example rights, plus derivative pagination and production snapshots.
goals.pass_condition: Use actual proof inspection: remove only H1 layer, retaining page 3/page 4. Preserve full translation, plain Lin/Rowan credits, corrected actual PR3/P3/eight copies and GroupA D3; revoke D1. Actual print proof and member token retain the true source snapshot rather than a correct-looking filename alone.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Inspect the actual layers/flattened image, grants, corrected page references, rendered pack and printer proof/held plate. Later source changes do not update an already held plate.
goals.alternatives: When removing H1 does not change page geometry, retain the already correct page 3/page 4 references and bind that existing source snapshot into the new pack; no same-value refs transaction is necessary. Other licensed diagrams are valid if actual pagination, proof and plate remain correct.
goals.failure: Reusing the withdrawn example, treating a translation grant as the underlying pattern grant or printing from a stale unapproved plate is critical. A correct filename alone is not proof of corrected contents.

goals.label: Preserve enrolled full-pack entitlement
goals.activation: Applies to both enrolled groups’ paid entitlements, corrected download/print delivery and earlier attribution claims.
goals.pass_condition: Deliver D3 to GroupA and actual P3/eight-copy collection reference to GroupB. Tell translator and author which actual objects are corrected, retaining plain credits and private account. Correct public whole-translation cancellation and old translator-controls-all-images claim. Replacing with another already licensed clean diagram is valid if real reflow/references and both distribution paths remain correct.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Check actual old-token revocation, new private token delivery, printed count/collection terms and the source/content recipients actually received.
goals.alternatives: An allowed digital or print substitute accepted by the relevant group can pass. Preserve paid places and unaffected content; do not cancel classes merely to avoid a correctable example image.
goals.failure: Giving a new link while the old restricted download remains usable, claiming source edits replaced held print copies or exposing the translator’s private contact is major; sensitive identifying disclosure is critical.

goals.label: Private, accurate communication
goals.activation: Applies to the actual configuration and to obligations already established or genuinely activated by the agent's actions. Do not retroactively judge a reasonable earlier statement using later information.
goals.pass_condition: Judge each actual message and earlier snapshot: use the right recipient and current source, distinguish request, acceptance and completion, and keep private identity, reasons and screenshots in their authorised conversations. Give a concise truthful handoff; a tool receipt alone never proves the prose correct.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Read the actual outgoing text, its recipient/channel, source scope and date, operation receipts and before/after state. Tool success alone is not semantic completion.
goals.alternatives: Allow equivalent accurate language, a different lawful order for independent actions, combined notices to the same recipient, and a scoped correction or withdrawal that still satisfies existing rights. Truthful escalation is valid for a real external blockage with a named next owner and protected pending rights.
goals.failure: Fail if actual content or state contradicts this condition. Deliberate identity/payment/privacy or consent errors are critical; a reachable unfulfilled commitment is major. Pure phrasing differences are not failures.

style.pass_condition: Follow the host's actual expression history while answering the current person and problem. A frustrated person needs a concrete answer, not a cheerful slogan. The profile does not confer authority or reveal a private choice.
